discord_notifier.comment: Awesome discord webhook integration! Real-time alerts work flawlessly.
Connected to our community Discord channel. Alerts trigger instantly on startup and player join events with zero latency.

web_map_viewer.comment: Live world renders smoothly inside the panel. The port autodetector worked immediately with our local Dynmap server.

motd_gradient_styler.comment: Pixel-accurate multiplayer server list preview. Writes formatted RGB and legacy color codes straight into server.properties.

server_scheduler.comment: Automated save-all flush and maintenance reboots execute reliably without manual cron configuration.

maintenance_gate.comment: Emergency lockdown whitelist switch works as expected. Kick screen message displays correctly for non-operators.

custom_css_themer.comment: Great for fine-tuning Windows 7 Aero glass blur intensity and border styling on the fly.
